text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are holding steady with matched modest gains, while Bitcoin's dominance at 60% suggests selective conviction in the largest assets over altcoins. The Fear & Greed index at 34 and declining 20 points over a week indicates growing caution despite stable prices, with broader weakness in mid-cap alts like Solana offsetting strength in large-cap names. Volume at $81B is moderate, reflecting hesitation rather than panic or enthusiasm.
